actionCalls.description: Calls an action that initiates a renewal for every asset tied to this contract, and sets the output type to the OutputType variable.
actionCalls.name: InitiateRenewal
actionCalls.label: Initiate Renewal

actionCalls.description: Per AC-7, notifies Adam Williams and the Account's assigned AE that automated renewal creation failed for this contract, with no automatic retry, prompting manual recreation of the Renewal Opportunity and Quote.
actionCalls.name: SendRenewalFailureNotificationEmail
actionCalls.label: Send Renewal Failure Notification Email

value.stringValue: Renewal Creation Failed - Manual Action Required

Automated renewal creation failed for the following Contract, and will not be automatically retried (the Contract is flagged Renewal Failed; clear that checkbox to retry).


View the Contract


Error:

{!renewalErrorMessage}


Any empty Renewal Opportunity created by this run has been deleted. Please resolve the cause (for example reactivate the product) or manually create the Renewal Opportunity and Quote for this contract.

actionCalls.description: Per AC-6, notifies the Account Team that a Renewal Opportunity and Quote were auto-created, with links to both and a Carried Forward / Excluded SKU breakdown.
actionCalls.name: SendRenewalNotificationEmail
actionCalls.label: Send Renewal Notification Email

value.stringValue:
A Renewal Opportunity and Renewal Quote have been automatically created for {!GetAccountCSM.Name}, ahead of the contract's expiration.


View the Renewal Opportunity

View the Renewal Quote


Carried Forward As-Is:

{!CarriedForwardSKUText}

Excluded from Renewal Quote:

{!ExcludedSKUSectionText}

assignments.description: Per AC-6, adds this Account Team Member's email to the notification recipient collection.
assignments.name: AddAccountTeamEmailToCollection
assignments.label: Add Account Team Email to Collection

assignments.description: Remembers an active product Id (comma separated text, checked per asset in the second pass).
assignments.name: AddActiveProductId
assignments.label: Add Active Product Id

assignments.description: Adds the grouping key of the current bundle touchpoint to BundleGroupingKeyIds.
assignments.name: AddBundleGroupingKeyToCollection
assignments.label: Add Bundle Grouping Key to Collection

assignments.description: Adds the confirmed root asset's Id back to AllLinkedAssetIds so it survives to the term-based filter and eventual renewal, since RemoveBundleChildAsset strips it (along with every other row in its group) beforehand.
assignments.name: AddBundleRootAssetId
assignments.label: Add Bundle Root Asset Id

assignments.description: Adds the AssetId of the current AssetContractRelationship record to the AllLinkedAssetIds collection variable, before filtering out one-time products.
assignments.name: AddContractAssetIdToCollection
assignments.label: Add Contract Asset Id to Collection

assignments.description: Per AC-6, records which products landed on the renewal Quote, so the contract's SKUs can be split into Carried Forward vs. Excluded.
assignments.name: AddRenewalQuoteProduct2Id
assignments.label: Add Renewal Quote Product Id

assignments.description: Adds the Id of the current term-based asset to ContractAssetIds, the final list passed to Initiate Renewal.
assignments.name: AddTermBasedAssetIdToCollection
assignments.label: Add Term-Based Asset Id to Collection

assignments.description: Collects the product Id of the current term-based asset.
assignments.name: AddTermBasedProduct2Id
assignments.label: Add Term-Based Product Id

assignments.description: Per AC-6, appends this contract SKU to the Carried-Forward list since its product appears on the renewal Quote's line items.
assignments.name: AppendCarriedForwardSKU
assignments.label: Append Carried Forward SKU

assignments.description: Per AC-6, appends this contract SKU to the Excluded list since its product does not appear on the renewal Quote's line items.
assignments.name: AppendExcludedSKU
assignments.label: Append Excluded SKU

assignments.description: Per AC-6, appends this expired/no-lifecycle contract SKU to the same Excluded list, since it never even made it to Initiate Renewal.
assignments.name: AppendExpiredSKU
assignments.label: Append Expired SKU

assignments.description: Records an inactive product, for the Excluded section of the notification.
assignments.name: AppendInactiveProductSKU
assignments.label: Append Inactive Product SKU

assignments.description: Asset skipped in the second pass: if it has no product linked at all (legacy data), record it in the excluded list (inactive-product assets are already listed by product).
assignments.name: AppendNoProductAsset
assignments.label: Append No-Product Asset

assignments.description: Per AC-6, snapshots the full set of linked asset Ids into AllLinkedAssetIdsBeforeFilter, right before ClearAllLinkedAssetIds wipes AllLinkedAssetIds, so the notification section can later identify which assets were dropped by the LifecycleEndDate filter rather than by the renewal itself.
assignments.name: CaptureAllLinkedAssetIdsBeforeFilter
assignments.label: Capture All Linked Asset Ids Before Filter

assignments.description: Captures the fault message when Set Quote Owner fails, instead of silently continuing, so the failure reason is visible for diagnosis.
assignments.name: CaptureQuoteOwnerError
assignments.label: Capture Quote Owner Error

assignments.description: Clears AllLinkedAssetIds now that it's been used to filter for term-based assets, so it doesn't carry over into the next contract.
assignments.name: ClearAllLinkedAssetIds
assignments.label: Clear All Linked Asset Ids

assignments.description: Clears ContractAssetIds entirely, giving up on this contract for today, when the fault message from Initiate Renewal can't be matched to a single asset.
assignments.name: ClearContractAssetsOnError
assignments.label: Clear Contract Assets on Error

assignments.description: Adds the current asset Id (not named in the error) to the list used for the retry.
assignments.name: KeepAssetIdForRetry
assignments.label: Keep Asset Id For Retry

assignments.description: Records that at least one errored asset was dropped, so a retry is worthwhile.
assignments.name: MarkErroredAssetRemoved
assignments.label: Mark Errored Asset Removed

assignments.description: Removes both the AssetId and RelatedAssetId of the current bundle group row from AllLinkedAssetIds, so bundle children never reach Initiate Renewal independently. The confirmed root gets added back separately by AddBundleRootAssetId.
assignments.name: RemoveBundleChildAsset
assignments.label: Remove Bundle Child Asset

assignments.description: Resets the retry list and flag before checking which asset Ids the latest Initiate Renewal error names.
assignments.name: ResetErroredAssetCheck
assignments.label: Reset Errored Asset Check

assignments.description: Per AC-6, clears the notification-building variables before assembling this contract's renewal creation notification, since they carry over between loop iterations otherwise.
assignments.name: ResetRenewalNotificationVariables
assignments.label: Reset Renewal Notification Variables

assignments.description: Every term-based asset on the contract has an inactive product, so nothing can be renewed. No Renewal Opportunity has been created yet.
assignments.name: SetNoRenewableAssetsError
assignments.label: Set No Renewable Assets Error

assignments.description: Per AC-7, captures the fault message when Create Renewal Opportunity itself fails, so the failure notification can include the actual reason instead of a stale or blank message. Goes straight to flagging the contract: no opportunity was created, so there is nothing to delete (deleting by the failed create's reference throws an uncatchable error).
assignments.name: SetOpportunityCreationErrorMessage
assignments.label: Set Opportunity Creation Error Message

assignments.description: Sets the renewalErrorMessage variable to the value of the fault message from the Initiate Renewal action.
assignments.name: SetRenewalErrorVariables
assignments.label: Set Renewal Error Variables

assignments.description: Pre-creation Owner fallback: the Account has an Account Executive, so it becomes the Renewal Opportunity's Owner.
assignments.name: SetResolvedOwnerFromAE
assignments.label: Set Resolved Owner From AE

assignments.description: Pre-creation Owner fallback: the Account has no Account Executive, so the source/parent Opportunity's owner becomes the Renewal Opportunity's Owner instead.
assignments.name: SetResolvedOwnerFromPreviousOpp
assignments.label: Set Resolved Owner From Previous Opportunity

assignments.description: Owner fallback tier 4 (last resort): no Account Executive, Account Team Member, or source Opportunity owner was found, so the Renewal Opportunity's Owner defaults to the running user, guaranteeing Owner is never blank at creation.
assignments.name: SetResolvedOwnerFromRunningUser
assignments.label: Set Resolved Owner From Running User

assignments.description: Owner fallback tier 2: no Account Executive on the Account, but an Account Team Member with role Account Executive was found, so they become the Renewal Opportunity's Owner.
assignments.name: SetResolvedOwnerFromTeamMember
assignments.label: Set Resolved Owner From Team Member

assignments.description: Replaces ContractAssetIds with the asset Ids that were not named in the Initiate Renewal error, so the retry excludes every errored asset.
assignments.name: StripErroredAssetId
assignments.label: Strip Errored Asset Ids

collectionProcessors.description: Filters GetFullBundleGroups down to just the rows belonging to the current grouping key.
collectionProcessors.name: FilterGroupByKey
collectionProcessors.label: Filter Group By Key

collectionProcessors.description: Filters the current group's rows down to those whose RelatedAssetId matches the current row's AssetId. An empty result means this AssetId never appears as another row's child, confirming it is the bundle's root.
collectionProcessors.name: FilterRootCheck
collectionProcessors.label: Filter Root Check

decisions.description: Determines the Renewal Opportunity's Owner before creation, since OwnerId is required and CreateRenewalOpportunity has no fallback of its own: Account Executive if assigned, otherwise an Account Team Member with role Account Executive, otherwise the source/parent Opportunity's owner, otherwise the running user.
decisions.name: HasAccountExecutiveForCreation
decisions.label: Has Account Executive For Creation?

decisions.description: Owner fallback tier 2: an Account Team Member with role Account Executive was found, so they become the Renewal Opportunity's Owner.
decisions.name: HasAccountTeamMemberForCreation
decisions.label: Has Account Team Member For Creation?

decisions.description: Per AC-6, skips sending the renewal creation notification when the Account has no Account Team Members to notify.
decisions.name: HasAccountTeamRecipients
decisions.label: Has Account Team Recipients?

decisions.description: Per AC-1, skips creating a duplicate Renewal Opportunity when an open one already exists for this contract.
decisions.name: HasOpenRenewalOpportunity
decisions.label: Has Open Renewal Opportunity?

decisions.description: Per AC-2, skips creating a duplicate Renewal Quote when an open one (Status not Accepted/Rejected/Denied) already exists for this contract.
decisions.name: HasOpenRenewalQuote
decisions.label: Has Open Renewal Quote?

decisions.description: Owner fallback tier 3: the source/parent Opportunity was found, so its Owner becomes the Renewal Opportunity's Owner. If not even that exists, the running user is the final fallback.
decisions.name: HasPreviousOpportunityOwnerForCreation
decisions.label: Has Previous Opportunity Owner For Creation?

decisions.description: Determines whether any bundle grouping keys were found for this contract's linked assets. If none, skips bundle resolution entirely and proceeds straight to the term-based filter.
decisions.name: HaveAnyBundleGroupingKeys
decisions.label: Have Any Bundle Grouping Keys?

decisions.description: Determines whether the fault message from Initiate Renewal could be matched to a single errored asset Id.
decisions.name: HaveAssetsWithRenewalErrorsIDs
decisions.label: Have Assets With Renewal Errors IDs?

decisions.description: Determines whether the grouping key of the current bundle touchpoint has already been recorded, to avoid processing the same bundle group twice.
decisions.name: HaveBundleGroupingKey
decisions.label: Have Bundle Grouping Key?

decisions.description: Determines whether any assets are linked to the current contract via AssetContractRelationship.
decisions.name: HaveContractAssets
decisions.label: Have Contract Assets?

decisions.description: Determines whether any assets remain in ContractAssetIds after stripping the errored one, to decide whether to retry Initiate Renewal.
decisions.name: HaveErroredAssetId
decisions.label: Have Errored Asset ID?

decisions.description: After inactive-product assets are removed: is there anything left to renew? If not, no Renewal Opportunity is created; the failure is recorded and reported instead.
decisions.name: HaveRenewableAssets
decisions.label: Have Renewable Assets?

decisions.description: Determines whether the current bundle group row's AssetId is a root asset, by checking whether it never appears as another row's RelatedAssetId within the same group.
decisions.name: HaveRootAsset
decisions.label: Have Root Asset?

decisions.description: Determines whether any of the contract's linked assets are term-based (survived the LifecycleEndDate filter), as opposed to one-time products which have no LifecycleEndDate.
decisions.name: HaveTermBasedAssets
decisions.label: Have Term-Based Assets?

decisions.description: True when the current asset Id is named in the Initiate Renewal error (the error can list one or several comma-separated asset Ids before the colon).
decisions.name: IsAssetInRenewalError
decisions.label: Is Asset In Renewal Error?

decisions.description: Only assets whose product is active are passed on to Initiate Renewal.
decisions.name: IsAssetProductActive
decisions.label: Is Asset Product Active?

decisions.description: Is this product active? Inactive products cannot be renewed (Initiate Renewal rejects them).
decisions.name: IsProductActive
decisions.label: Is Product Active?

decisions.description: Retries Initiate Renewal only if at least one errored asset was actually removed; otherwise the retry would fail the same way forever (CPU limit), so the renewal is failed cleanly instead.
decisions.name: WasAnyErroredAssetRemoved
decisions.label: Was Any Errored Asset Removed?

formulas.description: Adds the current product Id to the active product list.
formulas.name: AppendedActiveProductId

formulas.description: Per AC-6, appends the current loop iteration's product name to the running Carried-Forward SKU list.
formulas.name: AppendedCarriedForwardSKU

formulas.description: Per AC-6, appends the current loop iteration's product name to the running Excluded SKU list.
formulas.name: AppendedExcludedSKU

formulas.description: Per AC-6, appends the current loop iteration's product name to the running Excluded SKU list, for an expired/no-lifecycle asset that never reached Initiate Renewal.
formulas.name: AppendedExpiredSKU

formulas.description: Appends the current inactive product name to the running inactive SKU list.
formulas.name: AppendedInactiveSKU

formulas.description: Appends the current asset name to the excluded list when the asset has no product linked.
formulas.name: AppendedNoProductAsset

formulas.description: True when the current asset has a product and that product is in the active product list (CONTAINS with a blank value would be true, so blank is excluded explicitly).
formulas.name: AssetProductIsActive

formulas.description: Generates the single failed asset Id from the Initiate Renewal fault message, when the message matches the expected "AssetId: message" pattern.
formulas.name: ErrorAssetIdsFormula

formulas.description: Per AC-6 scenario 3, shows "Not Applicable" when every contract SKU carried forward as-is, instead of an empty Excluded section.
formulas.name: ExcludedSKUSectionText

formulas.description: Opportunity record type for the renewal: the Source Opportunity's record type if there is one, else from the Contract Name: MS- = Managed Services, PS- = Professional Services, neither = Managed Services. Never blank (a blank RecordTypeId fails the create).
formulas.name: f_NoSourceOppRecordTypeId

formulas.description: Error text when every term-based asset on the contract has an inactive product.
formulas.name: NoRenewableAssetsMessage
formulas.expression:
"No renewable assets - none of this contract's term-based assets has an active product: " & SUBSTITUTE({!InactiveSKUText}, "
", "; ")

formulas.description: Per AC-6, the org's base URL (everything before /services), used to build clickable record links in the renewal creation notification email.
formulas.name: OrgBaseURL

formulas.description: Per AC-7, clickable link to the Contract whose automated renewal creation failed, for the failure notification email.
formulas.name: RenewalFailureContractLink

formulas.description: renewalErrorMessage cut to the 255 characters of Contract.Renewal_Failure_Message__c.
formulas.name: RenewalFailureMessageForField

formulas.description: Per AC-12, Renewal MRR = the renewal Quote's Proposed (Current) MRR minus its Existing MRR â€” the net MRR change vs. the original contract.
formulas.name: RenewalMrrFormula

formulas.description: Close Date for the pre-created Renewal Opportunity: 30 days before the expiring contract's end date.
formulas.name: RenewalOpportunityCloseDate

formulas.description: Per AC-6, clickable link to the newly created Renewal Opportunity.
formulas.name: RenewalOpportunityLink

formulas.description: Per AC-6, clickable link to the newly created Renewal Quote.
formulas.name: RenewalQuoteLink

formulas.description: Per AC-12, Renewal TCV = the renewal Quote's Total Price minus its Existing TCV â€” the net TCV change vs. the original contract.
formulas.name: RenewalTcvFormula

loops.description: Repeats actions for each distinct bundle grouping key touching this contract, resolving each group down to its root asset.
loops.name: IterateOverBundleGroupingKeys
loops.label: Iterate Over Bundle Grouping Keys

loops.description: Repeats actions for each AssetRelationship row within the current bundle group, removing bundle members from AllLinkedAssetIds and re-adding only the confirmed root asset.
loops.name: IterateOverBundleGroupRows
loops.label: Iterate Over Bundle Group Rows

loops.description: Repeats actions for each Bundle-role AssetRelationship row touching this contract's linked assets, to collect the distinct grouping keys involved.
loops.name: IterateOverBundleTouchpoints
loops.label: Iterate Over Bundle Touchpoints

loops.description: Repeats actions for each AssetContractRelationship record tied to the current contract.
loops.name: IterateOverContractAssetRelationships
loops.label: Iterate Over Contract Asset Relationships

loops.description: Repeats actions for each term-based asset that survived the LifecycleEndDate filter.
loops.name: IterateOverTermBasedAssets
loops.label: Iterate Over Term-Based Assets

loops.description: Second pass over the term-based assets: only those whose product is active are added to ContractAssetIds.
loops.name: IterateOverTermBasedAssetsForRenewal
loops.label: Iterate Over Term-Based Assets For Renewal

loops.description: Classifies each product of the term-based assets as active or inactive.
loops.name: IterateOverTermBasedProducts
loops.label: Iterate Over Term-Based Products

loops.description: Per AC-6, loops the current contract's Account Team Members to collect their email addresses.
loops.name: LoopAccountTeamMembersForRenewal
loops.label: Loop Account Team Members For Renewal

loops.description: Checks every asset Id in the current renewal request against the Initiate Renewal error, keeping only the ones the error does not name.
loops.name: LoopAssetIdsForErrorCheck
loops.label: Loop Asset Ids For Error Check

loops.description: Per AC-6, loops the contract SKUs that landed on the renewal Quote, appending each to the Carried Forward text.
loops.name: LoopCarriedForwardSKUAssets
loops.label: Loop Carried Forward SKU Assets

loops.description: Per AC-6, loops the contract SKUs that did not land on the renewal Quote, appending each to the Excluded text.
loops.name: LoopExcludedSKUAssets
loops.label: Loop Excluded SKU Assets

loops.description: Per AC-6, loops the contract's expired/no-lifecycle assets (dropped by GetTermBasedContractAssets' own filter, never offered to Initiate Renewal at all), appending each to the same Excluded text as the SKUs the native action itself dropped.
loops.name: LoopExpiredSKUAssets
loops.label: Loop Expired SKU Assets

loops.description: Per AC-6, loops the renewal Quote's line items to collect the Product2Ids that landed on the Quote.
loops.name: LoopRenewalQuoteLineItemsForSKUReport
loops.label: Loop Renewal Quote Line Items For SKU Report

recordCreates.description: Pre-creates the Renewal Opportunity so Initiate Renewal associates the renewal Quote with an existing, correctly-configured record instead of auto-creating its own.
recordCreates.name: CreateRenewalOpportunity
recordCreates.label: Create Renewal Opportunity

recordDeletes.description: Initiate Renewal failed for good (no retry left), so the empty Renewal Opportunity created before it is deleted. Otherwise one empty opportunity would be created on every daily run.
recordDeletes.name: DeleteRenewalOpportunityOnFailure
recordDeletes.label: Delete Renewal Opportunity On Failure

recordLookups.description: Gets the Client Success Manager assigned to the account tied to this contract, queried directly on Account rather than as a cross-object field on Get Eligible Contracts, since Flow Builder's simple field picker for multi-record Get Records elements can't represent relationship-spanning fields without corrupting them. Runs before the Renewal Opportunity is created so the Opportunity (and, by extension, the Quote Initiate Renewal links to it) is already owned by the CSM instead of needing a later owner change.
recordLookups.name: GetAccountCSM
recordLookups.label: Get Account CSM

recordLookups.description: Owner fallback tier 2: looks up an Account Team Member with role Account Executive for this Account, used as the Renewal Opportunity's Owner when the Account itself has no Account Executive assigned.
recordLookups.name: GetAccountTeamMemberForCreation
recordLookups.label: Get Account Team Member For Creation

recordLookups.description: Per AC-6, gets the Account Team for the current contract's Account, so the renewal creation notification can be sent to them. Uses automatic field storage (no explicit queriedFields) so User.Email can be read via the loop variable, matching the proven pattern in Opportunity_AfterTriggerFlow's Get_Account_Team_Members.
recordLookups.name: GetAccountTeamMembersForRenewal
recordLookups.label: Get Account Team Members For Renewal

recordLookups.description: Per AC-7, resolves the email address of the Account's assigned AE, so they can be notified alongside Adam Williams when automated renewal creation fails for this contract.
recordLookups.name: GetAssignedAEEmailForFailureNotification
recordLookups.label: Get Assigned AE Email For Failure Notification

recordLookups.description: Gets Bundle-role AssetRelationship records where the related (child) asset is one of this contract's linked assets, so bundle groups touching this contract can be identified.
recordLookups.name: GetBundleTouchpoints
recordLookups.label: Get Bundle Touchpoints

recordLookups.description: Per AC-6, gets the contract's renewed assets whose product landed on the renewal Quote (automatic field storage so Product2.Name can be read via the loop variable), for the Carried Forward section of the notification. Split into its own query (rather than a single query plus a Decision check) since Decision conditions don't support "In" against a collection variable.
recordLookups.name: GetCarriedForwardSKUAssets
recordLookups.label: Get Carried Forward SKU Assets

recordLookups.description: Gets all AssetContractRelationship records for the current contract, so every asset on the contract is renewed regardless of its own auto-renew flag or lifecycle date.
recordLookups.name: GetContractAssets
recordLookups.label: Get Contract Assets

recordLookups.description: Per AC-6, gets the contract's renewed assets whose product did NOT land on the renewal Quote, for the Excluded section of the notification.
recordLookups.name: GetExcludedSKUAssets
recordLookups.label: Get Excluded SKU Assets

recordLookups.description: Checks whether an open Renewal Opportunity already exists for this contract, per AC-1's duplicate-prevention requirement.
recordLookups.name: GetExistingOpenRenewalOpportunities
recordLookups.label: Get Existing Open Renewal Opportunities

recordLookups.description: Checks whether an open Renewal Quote already exists for this contract, per AC-2's duplicate-prevention requirement. Accepted/Rejected/Denied are treated as closed/terminal.
recordLookups.name: GetExistingOpenRenewalQuotes
recordLookups.label: Get Existing Open Renewal Quotes

recordLookups.description: Per AC-6, gets the contract's assets that were dropped by the LifecycleEndDate filter before Initiate Renewal ever ran (expired or no lifecycle date at all), so they can be reported as Excluded alongside the SKUs the native action itself dropped.
recordLookups.name: GetExpiredSKUAssets
recordLookups.label: Get Expired SKU Assets

recordLookups.description: Gets every AssetRelationship row for each bundle group touched by this contract, so the full parent/child membership of each group is known (not just the rows involving this contract's assets).
recordLookups.name: GetFullBundleGroups
recordLookups.label: Get Full Bundle Groups

recordLookups.description: Owner fallback tier 3: looks up the source/parent Opportunity (via SourceOpportunityId) to find its Owner, used as the Renewal Opportunity's Owner when the account has no Account Executive or Account Team Member assigned.
recordLookups.name: GetPreviousOpportunityOwnerForCreation
recordLookups.label: Get Previous Opportunity Owner For Creation

recordLookups.description: Gets the OpportunityId of the renewal Quote created by Initiate Renewal, so the Opportunity can be enriched with linkage, ownership, and type.
recordLookups.name: GetRenewalQuoteDetails
recordLookups.label: Get Renewal Quote Details

recordLookups.description: Per AC-6, gets the renewal Quote's line items so their Product2Ids can be compared against the contract's original SKUs.
recordLookups.name: GetRenewalQuoteLineItemsForSKUReport
recordLookups.label: Get Renewal Quote Line Items For SKU Report

recordLookups.description: Per AC1, looks up the source/parent Opportunity's Description so it can be copied onto the new Renewal Opportunity. Runs unconditionally (unlike GetPreviousOpportunityOwnerForCreation, which only runs on the no-AE branch) since Description is needed regardless of which Owner-resolution path executes.
recordLookups.name: GetSourceOpportunityDetails
recordLookups.label: Get Source Opportunity Details

recordLookups.description: Filters the contract's linked assets down to only term-based, still-active ones: LifecycleEndDate must be set AND at or after today. The second condition excludes assets whose lifecycle has already ended (e.g. one-time onboarding fees, which carry a short LifecycleEndDate from their original one-time charge) - a defined-but-already-past LifecycleEndDate isn't eligible to be renewed and would otherwise make Initiate Renewal reject it with "Select Override Renewal Term to renew expired or future-dated assets."
recordLookups.name: GetTermBasedContractAssets
recordLookups.label: Get Term-Based Contract Assets

recordLookups.description: Gets the products of the term-based assets (queried directly on Product2 because Get Records does not load parent fields such as Product2.IsActive on Asset).
recordLookups.name: GetTermBasedProducts
recordLookups.label: Get Term-Based Products

recordUpdates.description: Sets Renewal_Initiated__c to true on every contract that was successfully renewed, so it isn't picked up again on a future run.
recordUpdates.name: MarkContractAsRenewed
recordUpdates.label: Mark Contract as Renewed

recordUpdates.description: Sets the ContractId on the Quote created by Initiate Renewal directly to the current contract's Id.
recordUpdates.name: Set_Quote_ContractId
recordUpdates.label: Set Quote ContractId

recordUpdates.description: Sets the Quote's Owner to the same fully-resolved Owner already used for the Renewal Opportunity (AE, then Account Team Member, then previous Opportunity Owner, then running user), so Quote Owner never falls back to the automated running user in cases the Opportunity's fallback chain already covers.
recordUpdates.name: Set_Quote_Owner
recordUpdates.label: Set Quote Owner

recordUpdates.description: Flags the contract as failed so the scheduled flow stops retrying it every day. Clear Renewal Failed to retry.
recordUpdates.name: SetRenewalFailureOnContract
recordUpdates.label: Set Renewal Failure On Contract

recordUpdates.description: Sets Opportunity linkage and Type. Owner is resolved once via the fallback chain at creation time (per AC-1) and intentionally not re-set here.
recordUpdates.name: Update_Opportunity_With_Owner
recordUpdates.label: Update Opportunity With Owner

variables.description: Per AC-6, stores the email addresses of the current contract's Account Team, resolved from AccountTeamMember.User.Email. Reset before each contract's notification is built.
variables.name: AccountTeamEmails

variables.description: Comma separated Ids of the active products among the term-based assets.
variables.name: ActiveProductIdsText

variables.description: Stores every asset Id linked to the current contract via AssetContractRelationship, before filtering out one-time products.
variables.name: AllLinkedAssetIds

variables.description: Per AC-6, a snapshot of every asset Id linked to the contract taken before AllLinkedAssetIds gets cleared - lets the notification section report expired/no-lifecycle assets as Excluded, since GetTermBasedContractAssets' own filter would otherwise drop them without a trace.
variables.name: AllLinkedAssetIdsBeforeFilter

variables.description: Stores the distinct bundle grouping keys touching this contract's linked assets.
variables.name: BundleGroupingKeyIds

variables.description: Per AC-6, accumulates the HTML list of SKUs carried forward as-is onto the renewal Quote. Reset before each contract's notification is built.
variables.name: CarriedForwardSKUText

variables.description: Stores a collection of asset IDs tied to the contract currently being processed.
variables.name: ContractAssetIds

variables.description: Per AC-6, accumulates the HTML list of contract SKUs excluded from the renewal Quote. Reset before each contract's notification is built.
variables.name: ExcludedSKUText

variables.description: Accumulates the HTML list of products skipped because they are inactive.
variables.name: InactiveSKUText

variables.description: Asset Ids not named in the latest Initiate Renewal error; becomes ContractAssetIds for the retry.
variables.name: KeptAssetIdsForRetry

variables.description: Stores the output type for assets renewed by the flow. Defaults to 'Quote'.
variables.name: OutputType

variables.description: Stores the fault message from Set Quote Owner, if it fails, so the reason is visible instead of silently continuing.
variables.name: quoteOwnerErrorMessage

variables.description: True when the latest error check removed at least one asset Id.
variables.name: RemovedAnyErroredAsset

variables.description: Stores the error message from the Initiate Renewal action.
variables.name: renewalErrorMessage

variables.description: Per AC-6, stores the Product2Ids present on the renewal Quote's line items, used to determine whether each contract SKU was carried forward. Reset before each contract's notification is built.
variables.name: RenewalQuoteProduct2Ids

variables.description: Resolved Owner for the Renewal Opportunity being created: the Account's Account Executive if assigned, otherwise the source/parent Opportunity's owner. Set before CreateRenewalOpportunity runs, since OwnerId is required and cannot be blank at insert.
variables.name: ResolvedOwnerId

variables.description: Product Ids of the term-based assets.
variables.name: TermBasedProduct2Ids
